eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant women aged 18 to 45 years
* Gestational age between 22 and 28 weeks
* Body mass index (BMI) between 19.0\~28.0 kg/m2
* Willingness to comply with the study protocol and provision of informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Known hypersensitivity or allergy to any active components or excipients of the study medications
* Multifetal gestation
* History of chronic constipation or functional defecation disorders prior to or during early pregnancy
* Current clinical hypercalcemia, hyperuricemia, familial hyperlipidemia, or intestinal malabsorption disorders
* History of prolonged extreme low-calcium diets or severe diagnosed nutritional deficiencies
* History of illicit substance abuse, chronic alcoholism, heavy smoking, or excessive caffeine intake

identificationModule.briefTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Low-dose Calcium Supplementation in Pregnancy
